libs.note:
BH-6350: the per-project dispatch mode (normal | hotfix-only | paused). The mode is the harness_flags row dispatch-mode- (value `hotfix-only` or `hotfix-only:,`; cleared = normal); paused is the existing paused- row. The fastpath, triage, run-build, fly-pool and fly-dispatch read it through dm_read. dm_age_alert pages once (lane-alert id dispatch-mode-hotfix-only:

) when hotfix-only has stood longer than DISPATCH_MODE_ALERT_H, resolved through lib_env_apply dispatch-mode . tests/dispatch-hotfix-only.bh-6350-test.sh drives it.

knobs.note:
Hours a project may stay in dispatch mode hotfix-only before one alert fires. The clock starts on the first tick that reads hotfix-only (state/dispatch-mode/

.since, seeded from the row's set_at), so an allow-list edit does not restart it. Per-project rows lib.dispatch-mode.

.dispatch_mode_alert_h win. Read by bin/lib/dispatch-mode.sh as ${DISPATCH_MODE_ALERT_H:-24}.
